title: Salty Dogs Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Salty Dogs is a 3 BR / 2 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. With a fanciful location just across from the sugary white sand, Salty Dogs opens up to a laid-back, beach lifestyle.
description_expanded: Description28 EAST RUSKIN STREET3 KINGS, 1 QUEEN AND TWIN TRUNDLE - sleeps 9 in totalWelcome to Salty Dogs | First-Block Seaside Beach RetreatWelcome to Salty Dogs, a stunningly renovated coastal home in Seaside, Florida, ideally located just 72 feet from beach access and a short stroll from downtown Seaside. Perfectly positioned on the first block of East Ruskin Street, this beautifully reimagined retreat blends classic Seaside charm with elevated modern design—making it an ideal vacation rental for families, couples, and beach lovers seeking a premier 30A location.Prime Location Near the Beach & Downtown SeasideOnce you arrive, enjoy the ease of a private driveway along with additional street parking. The home’s unbeatable location places you steps from Seaside’s sugar-white sands and within walking distance of over 35 shops, restaurants, and the iconic Seaside Amphitheater. From morning beach walks to sunset dinners downtown, everything Seaside has to offer is right outside your door.Wrap-Around Porch & Outdoor LivingStep onto the expansive wrap-around porch, designed for relaxed coastal living. With picnic-style dining, two rocking chairs, and a cozy bed swing, it’s the perfect spot for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or evening cocktails accompanied by the sound of nearby waves. Out back, a shaded private yard features Adirondack seating, a charcoal grill, and a peaceful deck—ideal for unwinding after a day at the beach.Fully Renovated Interior with Chef’s KitchenInside, Salty Dogs has been fully renovated with high-end finishes and coastal designer details throughout. The first floor showcases a chef’s kitchen with quartz countertops, a large central island with seating for four, custom cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator and a six-burner electric cooktop. A built-in dining nook comfortably seats six to eight, while the open-concept living room offers two sofas, club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for family movie nights or game-day gatherings.Thoughtfully Designed Bedrooms & Spa-Inspired BathsThis Seaside vacation home comfortably accommodates guests across four beautifully appointed bedrooms. On the first floor, a queen bedroom with a twin trundle features custom built-ins, a private TV, and porch access, with a nearby renovated hall bath offering a glass-enclosed tub/shower combination. Also on the main level is a front-facing king suite with porch access and a renovated ensuite bath featuring a sleek vanity and glass walk-in shower.Upstairs, two additional luxurious king suites await. The newly added primary suite includes a sitting area, blackout shades, a large flat-screen TV, and a spa-like bathroom with dual vanities, quartz counters, a deep soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed shower. The fourth bedroom offers another king bed, a flat-screen TV, barn doors leading to an extra lounge area, and access to a beautifully renovated hall bath with dual sinks and a walk-in glass shower with bench seating.Tower Room & Rooftop Deck with Gulf ViewsCrowning the home is the enclosed tower room, complete with seating and a TV, leading out to an open-air rooftop deck. With bar seating for two and glimpses of the Gulf, this elevated space is the perfect place to watch Seaside’s breathtaking sunsets and enjoy evening breezes high above town.The Ultimate Seaside, Florida Vacation RentalAdditional amenities include a full-size laundry room, an enclosed outdoor shower, and thoughtful touches throughout that enhance comfort and convenience. With its first-block beach location, upscale renovation, and walkable access to the best of Seaside, Salty Dogs offers a truly unforgettable Seaside, Florida vacation rental where beachside tranquility meets timeless coastal charm.* 5NT minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3NT minimum Fall; 2NT minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. **Private Level II electric car charging station located at Salty Dogs for guest use upon requestFEATURES2,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space1-minute walk, 72 steps to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion — one of the largest private beaches on 30AThree King bedroomsPrivate Level II electric vehicle charging station at Salty Dogs (available upon request)Expansive wrap-around open-air porch ideal for outdoor lounging and diningTower with Gulf views for sunset watchingPrivate drivewayPeacock Alley Linens — fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote filled with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002299
